claim: Cars lock into automated highway control systems.
originalWording: Cars lock into automated highway control systems.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: Business and Economics, prediction 18, printed p. 82

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Ordinary intelligent highways accept a vehicle into automatic road-control infrastructure while local roads remain conventional.
reference.rationale: Demonstrations of autonomy did not create the forecast’s functioning highway-control network in 2009. Automated vehicle capability has advanced substantially, but Waymo’s onboard autonomy is not the forecast’s road-embedded highway architecture.
